_about: Every number the simulator uses for the shell, with where it came from. 'measured' = taken from the real system on the dev PC (Windows 11 build 26300, 1920×1080 at 100 % / 96 DPI, Nov 2026); 'extrapolated' = reasoned or scaled from measurements and not checked against the real thing. Re-measure with the probes in sim/reference/probe/.

taskbar.source: UI Automation BoundingRectangle of Shell_TrayWnd descendants at 100 %

notifyIconImage.note: 16 px icon at (+8, +16) inside its 32×48 button

taskbar.check: qt-sim test → 'geometry vs UI Automation' must match all 12 elements exactly

otherScales.rule: every DIP size × scale, rounded per element (XAML layout rounding); small icon = SM_CXSMICON = 16/20/24/28/32 px at 100/125/150/175/200 %
otherScales.check: qt-sim test → 'physical-pixel integrity' proves the icon reaches the screenshot unresampled at every scale; it does not prove Windows lays out the tray identically at those scales

popupMenu.source: probe/menuprobe.cs: a real TrackPopupMenuEx menu with QuickTooth's items, flags and dark/light preferred app mode; GetWindowRect, GetMenuItemRect, WM_PRINT render (menu/*.png, menu/*.json)
popupMenu.font: Segoe UI 9 pt (12 px), GDI whole-pixel advances, no kerning
popupMenu.width: 38 + widest text + 60 (+1 if an item has a submenu arrow) — fitted to the two measured menus: 267 px and 230 px

placement.main: bottom = anchor y (TPM_BOTTOMALIGN), left = anchor x, clamped so the menu stays on the monitor (measured at anchors 1710,1032 / 1710,1056 / 900,1056)
placement.submenuRight: left = parent right − 6, top = item top − 3
placement.submenuLeft: right = parent left + 3 (when there's no room on the right)

popupMenu.check: qt-sim menu-check: sizes, item rects and placement must match exactly; non-text pixels mean |Δ| ≤ 1.5

popupMenuExtras.dwmCorners: 4 px radius (DWMWCP_ROUNDSMALL) + soft shadow — DWM effects don't appear in WM_PRINT and couldn't be captured while the PC was locked

systemTimer.source: probe/timerprobe.cs: SetTimer(83 ms) — TrayApp's animation timer — on the dev PC
systemTimer.model: interval = ceil(ms / 15.625) × 15.625 + 1.06 ms; so the real animation runs at ~10.5 fps, not 12

hoverAndTooltip.afterClick: tooltip hides on press and stays hidden until the pointer leaves the button (assumed)

overflowFlyout.newIconsStartHidden: Windows 11 behaviour; QuickTooth promotes itself once (TrayPromotion.cs). Explorer writing the NotifyIconSettings entry 1.2 s after NIM_ADD and reacting to IsPromoted at once are assumptions.

bluetooth.source: the dev PC's real %APPDATA%\QuickTooth\quicktooth.log, AirPods Pro 3
bluetooth.disconnectOrder: A2DP UNPLUGGED within ~50 ms of the request; HFP ~0.4 s later
bluetooth.linkLingerAfterDisconnect: ≈3 s ('waited 815 / 1019 / 1221 / 2054 / 2448 ms for the previous link to close', measured from the click)
bluetooth.batteryAdvertRead: ≈6.5 s after connecting; case level unknown while the buds are out ('case ?')
